info.title: ThreatBridge
info.description: The HTTP API of ThreatBridge's map (see docs/API.md for the conventions: times, windows, the time range, filters, POST queries and errors). Every response here lists every field it has.

delete.summary: Unmark a host, with the marked flows it is an end of

get.summary: What a client needs to know about this server (D20)
One connection, as it would be drawn

post.summary: One connection, as it would be drawn (as a POST, with filters and marks in the body)

requestBody.description: The query's parameters as a JSON object, plus `filters` and `marks`.

post.summary: Add an IP, CIDR or domain name
The marked hosts, and the marked and suspect flows on the drawn connections

get.summary: One page of a connection's flows, oldest first

requestBody.description: The query's parameters as a JSON object, plus `filters` and `marks`.

get.summary: One hop: who connected to a host before the anchor, or who it connected to after

schema.description: ISO-8601 (UTC unless it says), or epoch seconds or milliseconds

post.summary: One hop: who connected to a host before the anchor, or who it connected to after (as a POST, with filters and marks in the body)

requestBody.description: The query's parameters as a JSON object, plus `filters` and `marks`.

get.summary: Every time-respecting path between two hosts, or between the marked hosts (case backend)

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: from this host; with neither src nor dst, the paths between the marked hosts

ISO-8601 (UTC unless it says), or epoch seconds or milliseconds

requestBody.description: The query's parameters as a JSON object, plus `filters` and `marks`.

post.summary: A Security Onion flow's packets, from its sensor through SOC

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: the other host: every conversation between the two

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: the IOC time: the query ends there

schema.description: ISO-8601 (UTC unless it says), or epoch seconds or milliseconds

post.summary: How many flows carry each protocol in a time range (D20) (as a POST, with filters and marks in the body)

requestBody.description: The query's parameters as a JSON object, plus `filters` and `marks`.

get.summary: Check an IP and settle the anchor time a map starts from

parameters.name: ts
parameters.description: the IOC time; blank: see direction

schema.description: ISO-8601 (UTC unless it says), or epoch seconds or milliseconds

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: with no ts: inbound looks back from the end of what can be shown, outbound forward from its start

get.summary: The saved maps, or with name the one saved under it

post.summary: Save a map for every analyst
What the marks keep of the drawn connections (D16, case backend)

get.summary: Hosts and hops time-consistent with a conversation (case backend)

post.summary: Hosts and hops time-consistent with a conversation (case backend) (as a POST, with filters and marks in the body)

requestBody.description: The query's parameters as a JSON object, plus `filters` and `marks`.

mutualTLS.description: a client certificate signed by the ThreatBridge CA (python -m threatbridge serves plain HTTP locally)

write.name: X-ThreatBridge
write.description: required on every write: browsers can't add it to a cross-site request

range_from.name: range_from
range_from.description: start of the analyst's time range: only flows that started in it count

schema.description: ISO-8601 (UTC unless it says), or epoch seconds or milliseconds

range_to.name: range_to
range_to.description: end of the analyst's time range

schema.description: ISO-8601 (UTC unless it says), or epoch seconds or milliseconds

filter.name: filter
filter.description: a filter expression (D17); repeat for several, combined with AND

window.name: window
window.description: a number and a unit (s, m, h, d, w), at most max_window; default default_window

hops.name: hops
hops.description: hop limit, 1 to limits.hops; default threat_hops

from.name: from
from.description: the start of the first flow wanted

schema.description: ISO-8601 (UTC unless it says), or epoch seconds or milliseconds

to.name: to
to.description: the start of the last; default from

schema.description: ISO-8601 (UTC unless it says), or epoch seconds or milliseconds

E400.description: a parameter or the body is invalid; the message says which

E403.description: a write without the X-ThreatBridge header

E409.description: a map is already saved under that name

E500.description: a shared file (exclude list, marks, saved map) is not valid JSON; it is left for someone to fix

E501.description: this needs another backend (threat lines, paths and suspect connections: the case backend; PCAP downloads: Security Onion with a SOC API client)

E502.description: Elasticsearch or SOC failed or answered unexpectedly

Protocols.description: Zeek's service names (`ssl` for TLS, ...), plus `icmp` and `unknown`

Ports.description: the most used destination ports, up to 5

HostMarkIn.description: time: ISO-8601 or epoch; null or blank: unknown

FlowMarkIn.description: start as the flow list shows it, to the millisecond

Marks.description: marks to use instead of the shared ones (an opened map's own, D19)

map.description: as it was saved; the map saves a MapDocument

settings.description: the toolbar and the paths form: each field's text, by its element id

MapDocument.description: A saved map (D19, D22): its hosts where they were, its connections with their counts as drawn, the highlights (classes), the view, the toolbar, the filters, its own marks and the queries it was built from, in order. Version 1 (before filters and marks) has no filters, marks or queries. The map reads only what it understands and leaves out what is malformed.
